suggestion.problemOrOpportunity: Dated retimings and module refactors strand cross-references and status rows. Two forward retimings in five days each required a manual sweep across roadmap headings, index anchors, work-order titles and cites, ADR amendments and the map; this one left version-named cites in two open drafts, left the active order citing a module that no longer exports the named symbols, and marked an unverified rung implemented while released rungs still read planned.
suggestion.scope: Extend scripts/check-publication.mjs or add a sibling script that (a) resolves every open work order's Cites against current product headings and named package exports and (b) refuses implemented or verified index rows for roadmap rungs whose work order has no passing verification in docs/control/resume.jsonl. Forward-only: closed historical orders are exempt and nothing is backfilled.
affectedUsers: executors and verifiers reading cited sections cold
suggestion.expectedValue: Removes a recurring manual sweep from every retiming and refactor, and stops stale cites or premature status from reaching verification, where they cost independent-review bandwidth (the current binding constraint per Principle 9).
suggestion.uncertainty: Work-order Cites are free prose; a resolver needs a conservative pattern for heading and module references and may require a small cite convention before it can run strictly. The false-positive rate on existing drafts is unmeasured.
risks: A strict lint that blocks publication for prose it cannot parse
False positives on closed historical orders unless they are exempted by control-log state
Encouraging cite rewrites that obscure the time-indexed history of an order
alternatives: Keep manual sweeps but add a checklist of citing surfaces to each dated retiming note
Let WO-026's generated work-order index carry rung status derived from control evidence and leave cites unchecked
Do nothing until the next retiming and measure how many cites it strands
duplicationHints: WO-026 generated work-order index over control evidence
scripts/check-publication.mjs existing link, lock and status-vocabulary checks
suggestion.urgencyRationale: Not urgent. Schedule before the next forward retiming or alongside WO-026 activation; the evidenced constraint is operator review bandwidth, and this reduces review noise rather than adding capability.

resultEnvelope.summary: Read-only review of the WO-023 staged subject at base e3e639f. Measured: 170 of 170 kernel, compiler and skeleton tests pass, 8 of 8 WO-101 corpus tests pass, formatter and whitespace checks are clean, and tracked status is byte-identical after the build with only ignored dist output created. The compiled loadout, claim-free prefix-glob lowering, residue regeneration, lens-brief ceiling and refutation selection match the order and its cited doctrine; no settled decision is reopened. WO-029 is useful before WO-009, honest that it is unnecessary today, keeps FNV non-cryptographic, and states its v1 to v2 payload migration precisely. Seven findings: one major (two of five write-back duties absent: the adoption ledger entry and the 03 product-suggestions record) and six minor (stale cites after the retiming and the WO-016 refactor, index status ahead of evidence, a lens-scope validator bypass via a doubled separator, a non-standard schema keyword, an unreproducible dispatch hash, residue stance as renderer literals). One proposal packet: a reference-and-status integrity lint. The harness denied inline node probes, so two findings are by inspection with exact steps. Operator disposition is required.
